copy-constructs a 0x4C-byte speech clip record: the tag string (+0x00), the category string (+0x20), and three words (+0x40 volume, +0x44 category index, +0x48 age)

returns the current DJ entry's flag at +0x60 (the Random column)

when the entry index (DAT_00F87E00) is within the list: makes that entry current (DAT_00F87E38) and rebuilds the list of clip indices 0..n-1 (DAT_00F87E18), n = the number of samples under its tag (FUN_009B0520)

frees the clip list, sets the entry index to 0 and clears the current entry
true when the entry index (DAT_00F87E00) is past the last entry

returns the character's mover: the path agent at +0x5D8, or the steering module (+0x5DC, sub-object +0x78) when the mode at +0x5E0 is 1

calls TMCharacter_GetMover and its slot 0 with (goal, angle); vtable +0x14 of the runner states
blend of two angles across the wrap, then Math_WrapAngle; used for the turn and the heading smoothing

drops waypoints from the end of the route vector while the agent is within about its speed of the last one

writes or clears a flag on every grid cell along the route (LotGrid_SetCellFlagsAtWorld, flag argument 8)

looks up a finished path by request id under the critical section

creates the two critical sections, the two events and the worker thread
(start, goal) -> route; tries Grid_FindPath, then points part-way along and fanned round the straight line, then a one-point straight route

walks the parent links of the found nodes and converts each cell to a world point (cell * size + origin) into the route vector
moves a cell to the nearest cell that LotGrid_IsCellFree accepts for the mask, searching in growing squares
world point -> its cell -> LotGrid_SnapToFreeCell -> back to the cell's world point (unchanged when the cell was free)
